user_problem: References such as above, this section and duplicate headings can target multiple document locations.
unique_output: Location-specific reference map with explicit target IDs, multiple candidates and unresolved targets.
required_input: Bounded document excerpts, section IDs/headings and reference occurrences.
critical_rule: Do not choose the nearest-looking target when explicit identity is absent or ambiguous.
nearest_existing_and_difference: document-consistency-check compares factual statements; this resolves textual navigation references without judging facts.
acceptance_scenario: Two sections named Setup and a reference see Setup without anID produce two candidate targets, not a guessed target.
